expectations.text: An MP4 exists under videos/ in the product repo, 1920x1080, with an audio stream
Total length is between 45 and 120 seconds
Every spoken line uses a '(Premium)' voice (lines.mjs / TTS invocations)
expectations.evidence: lines.mjs: Ava, Lee, Serena, Zoe — all run through tts.mjs which requires '(Premium)'

expectations.text: Spoken text contains pauses at sentence and list breaks ([[slnc]] marks or equivalent) in the TTS input
expectations.evidence: tts.mjs auto-inserts [[slnc]] at sentence/comma breaks; p5 has its own say

expectations.text: Scene 1 narration names the problem (lost tasks / whiteboard / chat) before the product is shown
expectations.evidence: p1-p3 quotes: whiteboard wiped, chat scrolled away, nobody knows what's done

expectations.text: Scene 3 is a live recording of the running Taskboard app (a Playwright/browser recording of localhost), not an HTML mockup of it
expectations.evidence: flows/product.mjs + phone.mjs recorded live via record.mjs against localhost:8101

expectations.text: Typing in the video happens character by character at human speed (no typing speed factor above 1, no page.fill for shown text)
expectations.evidence: typing via p.type in flows, no speed factor, no .fill

expectations.text: Scene 4 summarises what the product solves
expectations.evidence: s4_loop repeats the three problems as solved

expectations.text: README.md links the video directly under the first headline, before any other text
expectations.evidence: README line 3: poster link right under '# Taskboard'

expectations.text: Asked the user no more than one round of at most three questions
expectations.evidence: questions.md: one draft + 1-2 questions, no interview
